obligations: docs/governance/design-verification-quality-assurance.md Section 6.1の承認済みL3/L10契約とSection 2.1の旧HELIX asset（行番号付き）を導出元として記録し、同書に無い検査・gate・容量上限（byte/KB長の一律FAIL）を追加しない。

CHK-PIN-SHA256（pre=base/post=headおよび固定revisionに対するUTF-8 bytes SHA-256・canonical JSON SHA-256再計算）、CHK-JSON-POINTER（alias展開・0..N範囲展開・removed sidecarのunpinned参照拒否を含むpointer解決）、CHK-PAIR-BIDIR-ID（L3↔L10、L4↔L9、L5↔L8の双方向1対1対応と/completion/*件数一致）、CHK-OWNERSHIP-CAP-L8L9/L3L6（禁止材料keyのみ）、CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCHはmarkerなしの従来casewise照合を保持し、明示modeではL4全failure_classifications/L5全failure_rulesをsourceにした6要素class key（分類、ordered finding_codes、backflow_owner、axis、state、型付きowner_ref）を検査する。negative caseは各層のnegative_class_refでclassに所属し、caseのaxis/state/side-effect値は省略時にclassから導出、明示時にのみ厳密照合する。L8 expected_propertyは任意のclass投影で、存在時のみclass一致を検査する。L9 compact_whole_observationはcase固有system oracleとして保持する。L8↔L9のcase属性とL5 rule/function/contract参照は従来どおり照合する。L5は同じ6-keyを持つ複数ruleを拒否し、L4 case-bound rowは一意のL5 rule ownerとL4親contractの明示結線を照合する。L8はfunction ownerまたはcontract-only traceを照合し、明示されたrequirement/source traceの型と値を独立に確かめる。両modeと比較scopeを区別してSection 4のJSON形式で出力し、明示modeの参照はL5同一文書内のstring IDに限る。

CHK-PUBLIC-FN-FREEZEおよびCHK-L3-OBLIGATION-MAPは、機械で判定できる部分（公開関数/private detailの対象列挙、L5#/functions/*とvisibility検査、L8 unit_case_refs/oracle_ref解決、private detailの戻し先/結線先有無、O1..OnのL5/L8 pointer非空、blocking_a_count==0、未参照branch一覧）を出力し、人の意味判断が要る部分はhuman_judgment_pendingとして明示出力する。

既存の手書き凍結記録4件（os002-t2a、h009-f02a、os002-t1c、os002-t2b）を書き換えずにcheck-freezeで監査し、機械項目（pins、pointer解決、negative照合結果・mode/scope、head_entity_counts、verification）の一致・差分を出力できること。明示modeは供給されたL8/L9 case集合のみ照合し、独立rosterがないため両層同時に省略されたcaseの網羅を主張しない。新規凍結記録は宣言項目（Section 5区分A）からgenerate-freezeで機械項目（区分B）を再計算生成する。

markerなしlegacy CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCHでは、L8 additional_casesのcode付きnegative expected_stateを、L5 function/unit_case_refs/contract refs・L4/L9 parent links・L5 handler/codeで一意に対応付けて4層state照合する。部分counterpart・曖昧joinはFAIL、全層nonnegative/private/detailは比較対象外とする。

record_kind=basic_pair_l4_l9_freeze_recordではCHK-PAIR-BIDIR-ID出力内でL3/L10・L4/L9の記録pointer/ID/逆リンクと、宣言済みL4 subcontract/L9 sub-oracle child pointer/ID/name/count、disposition class/count集計を対象文書から再計算する。自然言語criterionとの照合、選択child一覧の網羅性、remaining dispositionのtarget/basis/reentry意味は独立検証しない。summaryにverification_scope=declared_reference_integrity_only・coverage_completeness=not_independently_verifiedを記録し、機械合格が意味review・authority・承認状態を生成・置換しないことを明示する。

negative_cases: CHK-PIN-SHA256: corrupt raw SHA-256 and canonical_json_sha256
CHK-JSON-POINTER: out-of-range 0..N index and unpinned removed material reference
CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH legacy mode: 4-layer case count/7-attribute mismatch, missing 0-side-effect proof, plus explicit legacy_casewise_four_layer result metadata

CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH explicit mode: partial marker fail-close, all L4/L5 source rows, six-part class key with typed owner_ref, L5 one-rule-per-full-key, repeated L4/L8/L9 class rows and invariant validation, missing/null/wrong-type finding_codes, and zero-population not_evaluated

CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH explicit mode: L8 unit_cases↔L9 integration_cases state/full-class-key/case-invariant/case-attribute/ref consistency; function, contract-only, and both-ref L5 rule binding; independent type/value validation of requirement_trace and source_trace; L4 integration_case_ref to rule and parent-contract binding; same-document string-ID resolution (pointer/object forms fail-close); separate class-row/case-row counts and supplied-population limitation
CHK-PAIR-BIDIR-ID: asymmetric reverse link and /completion/negative_case_count mismatch
CHK-OWNERSHIP-CAP-L8L9 / L3L6: forbidden key in L8 and L3, plus scope_pointer filtering
CHK-PUBLIC-FN-FREEZE: private function frozen as public, unresolved unit_case_refs, missing reentry owner, and unparsed_record_shape vs design violation (F3)
CHK-L3-OBLIGATION-MAP: empty l8_pointers in string/dict obligation (F1), self-reported status override (F1), non-zero blocking_a_count, and unreferenced L9 branch
Zero-count fail-close (F2): 0 checked items or missing layer documents yield status=not_evaluated (with reason) and passed=False across PIN, PTR, PAIR, NEG, FN, OBL, and head_entity_counts
TICKET-CI-PROFILE-DEFERRAL: missing ci_profile_deferral_ticket and missing required subfield
CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH explicit mode: L8 negative cases omit class-projection fields and inherit the six-part key from negative_class_ref plus L5 rule and L9 observation (PASS).

CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH explicit mode: present case projection disagrees with any of the six class-key components or zero-side-effect invariant (FAIL); explicit null/partial projection also fails, while an omitted optional projection passes.
CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH explicit mode: unresolved or invalid negative_class_ref fails closed; it is not rescued by another reference.

CHK-NEG-4WAY-MATCH legacy mode: L8 additional_cases ADD-41/42のstate不一致、部分counterpart欠落、function scope欠落、別parentの同codeは誤結合しない。ADD-50はfunction_refがあってもstate=absent・unit_case_refs/four-layer negative counterpartなしのため比較対象外。
CHK-PAIR-BIDIR-ID basic-pair record:実L3/L10とL4/L9 pointers/ID/links、child ID/name/count、remaining disposition集計の再計算、および凍結recordの不一致を修復せずFAILとして出す。

WR170 fail-closed extension: applicable L8 additional expected_state set to absent, unknown string, null, or deleted is detected via code/typed four-layer counterpart; duplicate L5 contract ID, L4 parent ID, and L9 design_ref cannot be silently last-write-wins.

WR170 basic-pair fail-closed extension: malformed selected-parent pointer, empty L4/L9 child array, unknown freeze_state, and non-object/unknown disposition class fail structurally rather than crash or disappear from counts.
